  Beverly Hills City Council Litigation Committee will conduct

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  4th

  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Wednesday, August 12, 2026
  3:30 PM

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  Committee on any item listed on the agenda

  2) Discussion of Armstrong Law Group Rate Increase Request

  3) Discussion of Liebert Cassidy Whitmore Rate Increase Request

  4) Adjournment

  Huma Ahmed
  City Clerk

  Posted: August 10, 2026

  accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call (310) 285-1014
